architectures.name: Pulsatile Pressure-Driven Therapeutic Agent Transport
architectures.mechanism: Utilize the rhythmic pressure variations in the venous sinus to drive the transport of therapeutic agents from the CSF into the venous bloodstream.
architectures.eshunt_specific_relationship: The unique anatomy of the eShunt, with its permanent implantation in the venous sinus wall, allows for the exploitation of the pulsatile pressure variations to drive selective transport of therapeutic agents.

safety_states.therapeutic_state: Therapeutic agents are being transported into the venous bloodstream at a controlled rate.
safety_states.drainage_state: CSF is being drained into the venous bloodstream without any issues.
safety_states.failure_state: The transport mechanism has failed, and therapeutic agents are not being delivered to the venous bloodstream.
safety_states.emergency_state: The shunt has become occluded, and CSF is accumulating in the subarachnoid space.
